finding: The study found significant associations between genetic variants in genes related to the HPA axis (MC2R rs1893219 A>G and GLCCI1 rs37972 C>T), birth characteristics (low birthweight, C-section, and low maternal schooling), and childhood ALL risk.
mod_finding: C-section delivery was associated with increased risk for ALL (adjOR 1.59, 95% CI, 1.16-2.17).
